THIRD LEVEL PAGE
Meet Analogue Pocket. A tribute to portable gaming.
A multi-video-game-system portable handheld. A digital audio workstation with a built-in synthesizer and sequencer. A tribute to portable gaming.
Original Display Modes Transform Pocket&#x27;s display into the display on an original GB, GBC, or GBA. Quirks and all. Pocket&#x27;s 615ppi display allows astonishingly accurate recreation of original hardware display characteristics like backlight LCD effects, pixel grid patterns and LCD subpixel patterns.
Pocket does it all Pocket is the ultimate tribute to portable gaming. We designed four unique portable video game system based cartridge adapters that allow you to play your original game cartridges on. Game Gear, Neo Geo Pocket & Neo Geo Pocket Color, TurboGrafx-16, PC Engine & SuperGrafx & Atari Lynx. Each adapter includes several Original Display Modes specific to each system. So you can explore portable gaming history with no compromises.
AP_01 Game Gear The Game Gear Adapter allows you to play your original Sega Game Gear cartridges on Analogue Pocket. Three Original Display Modes are available with this: Analogue GG, Original GG, Original GG+.
